# macro.intensity_to_rabi_freq { #clerq.macro.intensity_to_rabi_freq }

```python
macro.intensity_to_rabi_freq(intensity, decay_rate, wavelength, factor=1.0)
```

Cyclic Rabi frequency of a field of the given intensity.

``Omega = Gamma * sqrt(factor * I / (2 I_sat))``, returned as ``Omega / 2
pi``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type   | Description                                               | Default    |
|------------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| intensity  | float  | Intensity at the atoms, in mW/cm^2.                       | _required_ |
| decay_rate | float  | Natural linewidth ``Gamma / 2 pi``, in MHz.               | _required_ |
| wavelength | float  | Transition wavelength, in nm.                             | _required_ |
| factor     | float  | Dipole moment squared relative to the cycling transition. | `1.0`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                   |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | float  | ``Omega / 2 pi`` in MHz, the value for a clerq ``rabi_freq``. |
